thesis: The episode introduces Jason Pfeiffer, editor-in-chief of Entrepreneur Magazine and author of 'Build for Tomorrow', who argues that adaptability is the single most important quality for success because it enables individuals to endure failures and rethink their roles when facing change. The discussion highlights that while people often ask about the qualities of successful entrepreneurs, the underlying pattern revealed is that success requires hanging on through enough failures to iteratively develop solutions that solve real problems.
